@mcp.tool()
def register_artifact(
    name: str,
    type: str,
    description: str,
    project: str | None = None,
    exp_id: str | None = None,
    source_path: str | None = None,
    content: str | None = None,
    content_filename: str | None = None,
    url: str | None = None,
    tags: list[str] | None = None,
    skill: str = "",
) -> str:
    """Register an agent-produced artifact (chart, report, paper, data, intermediate, feishu_doc).

    Args:
        name: Human-readable artifact name.
        type: chart | report | paper | data | intermediate | feishu_doc.
        description: Brief description of the artifact.
        project: Project name. None for global research scope.
        exp_id: Experiment ID. None to file under project-level.
        source_path: Local file to copy into artifacts directory.
        content: Raw text/HTML/JSON to write directly (for proxy workers without local file access).
        content_filename: Filename for written content (default: '{name}.txt').
        url: External URL (e.g. Feishu doc link), mutually exclusive with source_path/content.
        tags: Optional tags for filtering.
        skill: Name of the skill producing this artifact.
    """
    result = artifacts_mod.register_artifact(
        name=name, type=type, description=description,
        project=project, exp_id=exp_id,
        source_path=source_path, content=content, content_filename=content_filename,
        url=url, tags=tags, skill=skill,
    )
    return _tool_result_to_str(result)

"""Artifact registry — manage agent-produced documents, charts, and reports.

Organizes artifacts by scope:
  - Experiment-level: projects/{project}/artifacts/{exp_id}/{type}/
  - Project-level:    projects/{project}/artifacts/_project/{type}/

Each scope has a manifest.yaml that indexes all artifacts with metadata.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import shutil
import uuid
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

import yaml

from core import paths as _paths
from core.tools.result import ToolResult


ARTIFACT_TYPES = frozenset(
    {"chart", "report", "paper", "data", "intermediate", "feishu_doc", "video"}
)


@dataclass
class ArtifactRecord:
    id: str
    name: str
    type: str
    description: str
    path: str | None       # relative to WORKSPACE_ROOT; None for feishu_doc
    url: str | None        # external URL (Feishu doc etc.)
    project: str | None
    exp_id: str | None
    skill: str
    created_at: str
    tags: list[str]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Internal helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _new_id() -> str:
    ts = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%d")
    uid = uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]
    return f"art_{ts}_{uid}"


def _manifest_path(project: str | None) -> Path:
    if project:
        return _paths.project_artifacts_dir(project) / "manifest.yaml"
    # Fallback: shared artifacts (no project context)
    return _paths.project_artifacts_dir("_shared") / "manifest.yaml"
